[[Category: Control Types]]

{{CT|intro

|macro = CT_SLIDER
|value = 3
|description = {{Feature|important|This slider is deprecated. You might want to use [[CT_XSLIDER]].}}
A slider can be used to make the user select a value in a predefined range.<br>
[[File:Arma RscSlider.jpg]]
|commands =
* [[sliderPosition]]
* [[sliderRange]]
* [[sliderSetPosition]]
* [[sliderSetRange]]
* [[sliderSetSpeed]]
* [[sliderSpeed]]
* [[BIS_fnc_initSliderValue]]
|events =
* [[User_Interface_Event_Handlers#onSliderPosChanged|onSliderPosChanged]]
}}

{{CT|abc start}}
=== C ===
{{CT|attribute
|name=color
|type1=Array
|value1={1,1,1,0.8}
|description=Color of the slider.
}}

{{CT|attribute
|name=colorActive
|type1=Array
|value1={1,1,1,1}
|description=Color when the slider is focused.
}}

=== S ===
{{CT|attribute
|name=sliderPosition
|type1=Number
|value1=42
|description=Inital value the slider is set to when loaded.
}}

{{CT|attribute
|name=sliderRange
|type1=Array
|value1={0,100}
|description=Slider range in format {min,max}.
}}

{{CT|attribute
|name=sliderStep
|type1=Number
|value1=1
|description=Size of the steps when slider is dragged, eg if sliderStep is 1 only integers are possible for the slider value.
}}

=== T ===
{{CT|attribute
|name=Title
|type1=Class
|value1=class Title
{
	idc = -1;
	colorBase[] = {1,1,1,1};
	colorActive[] = {1,0.5,0,1};
};
|description=
}}

=== V ===
{{CT|attribute
|name=Value
|type1=Class
|value1=class Value
{
	idc = 1200;
	format = "%.f";
	type = "SPTPlain";
	colorBase[] = {1,1,1,1};
	colorActive[] = {1,0.5,0,1};
};
|description=
}}

{{CT|abc end}}

{{CT|examples}}
=== RscExample ===
<syntaxhighlight lang="cpp">
class RscSlider
{
	deletable = 0;
	fade = 0;
	access = 0;
	type = CT_SLIDER;
	style = SL_HORZ;
	color[] = {1,1,1,0.8};
	colorActive[] = {1,1,1,1};
	shadow = 0;
	x = 0;
	y = 0;
	w = 0.3;
	h = 0.025;
};
</syntaxhighlight>
